title: Find the district name (A2) with the highest total transaction amount in 19
question: Find the district name (A2) with the highest total transaction amount in 1997 among districts that have at least one active loan (status 'C' or 'D') and where more than half of the clients linked to accounts with weekly statement issuance ('POPLATEK TYDNE') are male.

prediction.sql:
WITH active_loan_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_002 AS district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.XCL_034 = a.XCL_001
    WHERE l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
),
weekly_statement_clients AS (
    SELECT 
        a.XCL_002 AS district_id,
        c.XCL_009 AS client_id,
        c.XCL_010 AS gender
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
    JOIN client c ON d.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
district_gender_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        district_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM weekly_statement_clients
    GROUP BY district_id
),
valid_districts AS (
    SELECT 
        ald.district_id
    FROM active_loan_districts ald
    JOIN district_gender_stats dgs ON ald.district_id = dgs.district_id
    WHERE dgs.male_count * 2.0 > dgs.total_count
),
district_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        a.XCL_002 AS district_id,
        SUM(t.XCL_051) AS total_amount
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
    WHERE t.XCL_048 LIKE '1997%'
    GROUP BY a.XCL_002
)
SELECT 
    d.XCL_018
FROM district_transactions dt
JOIN valid_districts vd ON dt.district_id = vd.district_id
JOIN district d ON dt.district_id = d.XCL_017
ORDER BY dt.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 1

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH active_loan_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_002 AS district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.XCL_034 = a.XCL_001
    WHERE l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
),
weekly_statement_clients AS (
    SELECT 
        a.XCL_002 AS district_id,
        c.XCL_009 AS client_id,
        c.XCL_010 AS gender
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
    JOIN client c ON d.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
district_gender_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        district_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM weekly_statement_clients
    GROUP BY district_id
),
valid_districts AS (
    SELECT 
        ald.district_id
    FROM active_loan_districts ald
    JOIN district_gender_stats dgs ON ald.district_id = dgs.district_id
    WHERE dgs.male_count * 2.0 > dgs.total_count
),
district_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        a.XCL_002 AS district_id,
        SUM(t.XCL_051) AS total_amount
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
    WHERE t.XCL_048 LIKE '1997%'
    GROUP BY a.XCL_002
)
SELECT 
    d.XCL_018
FROM district_transactions dt
JOIN valid_districts vd ON dt.district_id = vd.district_id
JOIN district d ON dt.district_id = d.XCL_017
ORDER BY dt.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM district d
WHERE d.XCL_017 IN (
    SELECT a.XCL_002
    FROM account a
    WHERE a.XCL_001 IN (SELECT l.XCL_034 FROM loan l WHERE l.XCL_039 IN ('C','D'))
)

    SELECT a2.XCL_002

    JOIN client c ON c.XCL_009 = dp.XCL_014

    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_010 = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(c.XCL_009) > 0.5
)
